info.submission: Solved. Reversed /app/vulnerable: gets() into a 0x58 stack buffer, then auth gate compares DWORD [rsp+0x40] == 1. Sending 0x40 filler bytes followed by b"\x01\x00\x00\x00" bypasses auth, reaching a routine that XOR-decrypts the .data blob at 0x404060 with 0x42 until the 0x42 terminator and prints "Access granted! Secret: FLAG{b4ff3r_0v3rfl0w_m4st3r_k3y_2024}". That exact flag is written to /app/results.txt (37 FLAG chars), public check public-task passed, and candidate-001 is saved with the verification evidence and unmodified binary digest.
